## On-call handoff: gateway 503s

**Root cause**
`dep-4471` (gateway, `a.novak`, "config: connection-per-request for pool isolation") flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest: false -> true` in config generation 119, applied `2026-03-14T02:13:41.234Z`. Pool connections stopped being shared across requests, exhausting the fixed pool (`size 20`). Every request now blocks on `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`.

**Impact window**
Started `2026-03-14T02:14:18.972Z` (first 503, `req-07401 /v1/cart`). Still ongoing as of the last log line, `2026-03-14T03:59:27.974Z` — not yet self-healed. `waiting` queue has climbed from 13 to 172+ and keeps growing. Gateway-only: `worker.log` shows no errors, jobs completing normally throughout.

**Rollback**
Roll back `dep-4471` — revert `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false` (or bump pool size as a stopgap). This is the only gateway deploy in the window; `dep-4472` (billing-svc, `02:41Z`) and `dep-4473` (catalog-svc, `03:20Z`) are unrelated and don't need touching.

Next: revert config gen 119, confirm `waiting` drops to 0 and 503s stop.
